title: Gram–Jacobian algebra: J_{L∘A} ≤ ‖L‖ⁿJ_A, |α(Ae)| ≤ J_A‖α‖, and a unit orientation of range A equals ±Ae/J_A
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and A : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P a (continuous) linear map; write e₁, …, eₙ for the standard basis of ℝⁿ (EuclideanSpace.single j 1), Ae := (Ae₁, …, Aeₙ), and J_A := (det(A*∘A))^{1/2} (A* = A.adjoint, det of the endomorphism A*∘A of ℝⁿ; ContinuousLinearMap.det). Then: (a) for every linear L : ℝ^P → ℝ^P, J_{L∘A} ≤ ‖L‖ⁿ·J_A (operator norm of L); (b) for every n-covector α of ℝ^P (α ∈ Covector (Euclid P) n, a continuous alternating n-linear form, with its operator norm ‖α‖), |α(Ae)| ≤ J_A·‖α‖; (c) if A is injective, then for every ξ ∈ Λ_n(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P n) which is a unit orientation of range A (IsUnitOrientationOf ξ (range A)) there is s ∈ {1, −1} with J_A·ξ(α) = s·α(Ae) for every n-covector α.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid P), (∀ L : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P, Real.sqrt (((L ∘L A).adjoint ∘L (L ∘L A)).det) ≤ ‖L‖ ^ n * Real.sqrt ((A.adjoint ∘L A).det)) ∧ (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |α (fun j => A (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))| ≤ Real.sqrt ((A.adjoint ∘L A).det) * ‖α‖) ∧ (Injective A → ∀ ξ : MultiVector P n, IsUnitOrientationOf ξ (LinearMap.range (A : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P)) → ∃ s : ℝ, (s = 1 ∨ s = -1) ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, Real.sqrt ((A.adjoint ∘L A).det) * ξ α = s * α (fun j => A (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))))
